name: AI Operations — knowledge base
about: The AI Operations knowledge base (product, pricing, guide and policy) for the svc-aide consultant and the Zap Support extension. Content is written once, in English (the canonical language); the assistant answers in the visitor's language. Every item has id / type / title / content / url / tags: tags are the one keyword list, in both English and Vietnamese (what customers actually type), so a Vietnamese question finds the right English item without a translated copy of the content. Sentences are short and self-contained so a small model can quote them. Load it in Consult → ⚙ → Load from API & MCP. url is the page with the full details — the assistant appends it to its answer (it is never translated or rewritten by the model).

items.title: AI Operations
items.content: AI Operations is made by Golden Key IT Solutions Joint Stock Company. AI Operations automates customer engagement and optimizes business operations with AI. AI Operations has two layers that share one knowledge base. The Starter plan gives you svc-aide, an AI consultant that answers your website visitors 24/7 from your own knowledge, with sources. The svc-aide consultant is embedded on your website with one script tag. The Pro plan includes everything in Starter plus svc-talk, an AI Secretary that takes work from the boss and routes it to 9 AI departments. The 9 AI departments are Strategy, Product, Marketing, Commercial, Operations, Supply, Quality, Finance and Technology. On the Pro plan, you approve the key steps of the work. AI Operations prices are in USD, paid with PayPal, with a 14-day free trial and cancel any time. You can chat with the sample consultant of AI Operations for free. Any signed-in account can trial the AI Operations workspace.

items.title: AI Operations plans and prices
items.content: AI Operations has three tiers: Free, Starter and Pro. The Free tier costs $0 and needs no card. On the Free tier you can chat with the sample consultant, and once signed in, trial the Secretary and 9 departments with limits. The Starter plan costs $12/month billed monthly, or $9/month billed $108/year. The Starter plan gives you the svc-aide consultant with your own knowledge base, loading over API or MCP, and embedding on your website. The Pro plan costs $24/month billed monthly, or $19/month billed $228/year. The Pro plan includes everything in Starter plus the AI Secretary (svc-talk) and all 9 departments, up to 100 jobs a day across your company. Both paid AI Operations plans start with a 14-day free trial. AI Operations prices are in USD, paid with PayPal. Buy or manage an AI Operations plan on the pricing page.

items.title: Starter plan
items.content: The Starter plan costs $12/month, or $108/year ($9/month), with a 14-day free trial. The Starter plan includes the svc-aide AI consultant, which answers visitors 24/7 from your own knowledge base, with sources. The Starter plan uses hybrid vector + keyword search that also catches SKUs and proper names. On the Starter plan, the consultant replies in the visitor's language (Vietnamese or English). On the Starter plan, your assistant has its own name and avatar. On the Starter plan, you load knowledge from a JSON API by pasting one URL. On the Starter plan, you can also let an AI (Claude, Cursor, VS Code) load knowledge over MCP, with one-click install. On the Starter plan, knowledge is organised by type, sector and department, and indexed automatically. On the Starter plan, you embed the consultant on any website with one script tag, a light or dark look, and the button placement of your choice. On the Starter plan, chat history is kept in the visitor's browser for 30 days. On the Starter plan, every customer's knowledge is walled off, and MCP tokens are stored only as SHA-256 hashes. The Starter plan includes email support.

items.title: Pro plan
items.content: The Pro plan costs $24/month, or $228/year ($19/month), with a 14-day free trial. The Pro plan includes everything in Starter, plus the AI Secretary (svc-talk). With the AI Secretary on Pro, you hand over work in one sentence, and the Secretary frames the job and assigns it. The Pro plan has an editable routing board, where you add or drop departments and change the lead. On the Pro plan, you can follow the handoffs between departments in the chat. On the Pro plan, complex work ends with one verdict: Approve, Approve with conditions, Hold or Reject. The Pro plan includes all 9 expert departments, each running a multi-step process with expertise specific to your sector. On the Pro plan, you approve step by step, edit by hand, or turn on Auto, and handoffs are versioned. On the Pro plan, approved results become knowledge reused by the next department and by your consultant. The Pro plan includes a canvas workspace per sector, one command bar for every AI, and priority support. The Pro plan is limited to 100 jobs a day across your company.

items.title: Free tier and workspace trial
items.content: AI Operations is free to try. With no card and no sign-up, you can chat with the sample consultant on the AI Operations website. The sample consultant answers from the platform's shared knowledge and keeps your chat in your own browser for 30 days. Sign in, with no purchase needed, and you can trial the whole AI Operations workspace. The free workspace trial includes the AI Secretary and 9 departments on the canvas, in all 5 sectors: E-commerce, Education, F&B, Healthcare and Real Estate. The free workspace trial also covers sectors not yet released. The trial limits apply per account and per sector, for good: 1 team task through the Secretary, 1 job per department, and 30 chat messages. Trial jobs cannot be regenerated or re-run. Approving works in the trial, but the results are saved as draft knowledge. Draft knowledge from the trial is still there when you upgrade. Start the free trial in the AI-Ecommerce workspace.

items.title: How payment, the 14-day trial and cancelling work
items.content: AI Operations is paid with PayPal, in US dollars, because PayPal does not accept VND. You can choose monthly or yearly billing for AI Operations. Yearly billing saves $36 a year on Starter ($108 instead of $144). Yearly billing saves $60 a year on Pro ($228 instead of $288). Every paid AI Operations plan starts with a 14-day free trial. You can cancel any time, in the Your plan panel on the pricing page or in your PayPal automatic payments. To buy, switch or manage your plan, go to the pricing page. On the pricing page, sign in with the account button in the corner, using Google or an email link. Then pick a plan and a billing period, and pay with PayPal. The purchase page also lists the plans you already bought.

items.title: What happens when the plan lapses or is cancelled
items.content: Cancelling an AI Operations plan stops renewal, and there are no further charges. After cancelling, you keep using the plan until the end of the period already paid for, or until the trial ends if you cancel during the trial. If PayPal cannot collect a renewal, the plan keeps working for 3 grace days after the period ends. After the 3 grace days, the embedded svc-aide consultant, the MCP server, the Secretary and the departments stop serving your knowledge until you pay or subscribe again. While the plan has lapsed, requests answer 402. Your knowledge base is kept when the plan lapses, so renewing picks up where you left off. After renewing, open the consultant's ⚙ settings once to refresh. AI Operations has no lock-in: knowledge loaded from your own API is a copy, and the source stays in your own systems.

items.title: Upgrading from Starter to Pro
items.content: Upgrading from Starter to Pro loses nothing: your knowledge base, your MCP token and your embed code stay the same. The AI Secretary and the 9 departments open right after the upgrade to Pro, because the billing is re-checked at once. After the upgrade to Pro, the Secretary and the departments work from that same knowledge. Upgrade from Starter to Pro on the pricing page.

items.title: The email you get after buying a plan
items.content: Right after you buy Starter or Pro, an email titled MCP token arrives. The MCP token email contains the MCP endpoint, your MCP_TOKEN (shown only this once) and embed code with your owner (hub id) already filled in. If the MCP token email does not arrive, sign in to the AI-Ecommerce workspace and open the Consult node. Then press ⚙, go to Load from API & MCP and press Activate MCP; the token is shown once. You can also use Issue a new token in the MCP section of the guide.

items.title: Quick start: from purchase to the first answer
items.content: You can have the AI Operations consultant answering visitors in about ten minutes, with no developer needed. Step 1: Buy a plan on the pricing page with PayPal; the email brings your MCP endpoint, MCP_TOKEN and embed code. Step 2: Load knowledge by pasting a JSON API link in the consultant's settings, or install MCP and ask your AI to load it. Step 3: Embed the consultant by pasting two lines into your website, right before the closing body tag. Step 4: Open your page, tap the assistant and ask something only your knowledge knows. Step 5, on Pro: Open the AI-Ecommerce workspace, sign in and message the Secretary.

items.title: svc-aide AI consultant
items.content: The svc-aide AI consultant is a floating chat on your website that answers visitors from your own knowledge base, with the sources it used. Visitors do not need to sign in to chat with the svc-aide consultant. The svc-aide consultant answers ONLY from the knowledge of its owner, which is your hub. The svc-aide consultant searches your knowledge with hybrid vector + keyword search. The svc-aide consultant replies in the visitor's language (Vietnamese or English). The svc-aide consultant acts as the Consult department of one sector, called a division, for example ecommerce.consult. You set the name and avatar of your svc-aide consultant. Questions to the svc-aide consultant are capped at 2,000 characters. The server keeps no visitor chats, and the history stays in the visitor's browser. The svc-aide consultant is the only part of AI Operations that can be embedded on your own website. The Secretary and the departments run in the hosted workspace, not on your website.

items.title: How to embed the consultant on a website
items.content: Embedding the svc-aide consultant takes two lines, pasted right before the closing body tag of every page or of your shared layout. Line 1 of the embed code is a script tag with type=module and src=https://chatzui.com/embed/svc-aide.js. The file svc-aide.js is one self-contained JS file, with no dependencies, and it works on any domain. Line 2 of the embed code is the svc-aide tag with division=ecommerce.consult and owner=YOUR_HUB_ID. Replace YOUR_HUB_ID with the owner from your purchase email; the email contains the full code ready to copy. The script tag of the embed code must keep type=module. The owner in the embed code is not a secret: it only lets the assistant read your knowledge to answer visitors. Writing or deleting knowledge always needs your token or a sign-in.

items.title: Embedding on WordPress, Shopify, Haravan, Wix and other platforms
items.content: The svc-aide consultant works on any platform that allows a custom script. On plain HTML, paste the two lines right before the closing body tag on every page or on the shared layout. On WordPress, use a header/footer code plugin, for example WPCode, and paste into Footer, or use a Custom HTML block in a footer widget. On Shopify, go to Online Store → Themes → Edit code → layout/theme.liquid and paste before the closing body tag. On Haravan or Sapo, go to Themes → Edit code → the main layout file and paste before the closing body tag. On Wix, Squarespace or Webflow, use the site's Custom code or Code injection, placed at Body – end. Some site builders block custom scripts on free tiers.

items.title: svc-aide tag attributes
items.content: The svc-aide tag has several attributes you can set. The owner attribute is your hub id from the purchase email; the assistant answers only from this knowledge base, and an empty owner means the platform's shared knowledge. The division attribute is one sector's Consult, written as sector.consult; the one open now is ecommerce.consult. The theme attribute is dark (the default) or light. The lang attribute is vi (the default) or en and sets the interface text; answers follow the visitor's language. The x and y attributes set the floating button position, by default 99% and 65%, like background-position. The types attribute limits answers to the listed knowledge types, joined with a vertical bar, for example product|faq; empty means every type. The embedded attribute removes the floating button and shows just the chat panel, filling its container.

items.title: Inline chat, colors and fonts of the embedded consultant
items.content: To place the svc-aide chat inside the page instead of a floating button, add the embedded attribute to the svc-aide tag. Put the embedded svc-aide tag in a sized container, for example a div with height 560px and max-width 420px, and the chat fills it. The svc-aide bundle ships a default palette applied to the svc-aide tag only, so the rest of your page is untouched. You can override the svc-aide colors from your site's CSS on the svc-aide selector. The --color-primary variable sets the accent for buttons and the focus ring. The --color-base-100 variable sets the panel background. The --color-base-content variable sets the text color, and --font-sans sets the font family.

items.title: Where visitor chat history is stored
items.content: Visitor conversations with the svc-aide consultant live in the visitor's own browser (IndexedDB). Visitor chat history is kept per consultant and per person, and cleared after 30 days. The AI Operations server does not keep visitor chats. Each question is sent with only the last few turns for context, answered, and nothing is stored. A signed-in user gets their own chat history, separate from other accounts on the same browser.

items.title: How the knowledge base works
items.content: The AI Operations consultant answers only from your knowledge rows, so each row must be self-contained, with a title plus content. Each knowledge row has a type: product, faq, law, post, technical, finance, medical, other, or your own. Each knowledge row has a scope, a sector and a department; consult means the visitor chat, and empty means shared by all. Knowledge search combines vectors and keywords, so it also finds exact SKUs and names. Long knowledge rows are split into passages and indexed automatically. Knowledge rows sharing a tag are linked, so an answer pulls in related knowledge. Draft knowledge rows are stored but never found. Knowledge rows of type finance are never used to answer visitors. Every customer's knowledge is walled off: no one else can read, write or delete it.

items.title: Loading knowledge from a JSON API
items.content: To load knowledge from a JSON API, follow these steps. Step 1: Open the AI-Ecommerce workspace and sign in with the Account node (top right), using the account that bought the plan. Step 2: Open the Consult node, press the ⚙ button atop the chat, and choose Load from API & MCP. Step 3: Paste the link, pick a Type and who uses it (this department, the whole sector, or every sector), then press Preview and Load. Preview shows 5 samples and the field mapping. Loading knowledge from a JSON API needs no field mapping, because the first array is found automatically. The loader guesses title/name/question, description/content/answer, id/slug/sku and tags. Each JSON API load is limited to 200 items and 5 MB, with up to 20 saved sources. Reloading a saved source (⟳ under Saved sources) updates rows by id and never duplicates them.

items.title: What is MCP and do I need it?
items.content: MCP (Model Context Protocol) is the standard that lets AI assistants such as Claude, Cursor or VS Code use outside tools. With the AI Operations MCP server installed, you just say load the new price list into the assistant, and the AI does it. Over MCP, the AI can read an API, a file (PDF, Markdown, spreadsheet) or text you paste, split it into self-contained items and load them into your knowledge base. MCP is optional, because loading from a JSON API in the consultant's settings works too. Every AI Operations MCP tool is scoped to your token's hub. The guide has one-click MCP install.

items.title: Installing the MCP server in Claude, Cursor, VS Code or Windsurf
items.content: The AI Operations MCP server speaks Streamable HTTP and is authenticated with the header Authorization: Bearer MCP_TOKEN. To install the MCP server, open the MCP section of the guide and paste your token, or sign in to issue a new one, filled in for you. Then pick a client in the MCP section; the token never leaves your browser. For Cursor and VS Code, one-click buttons open the app and ask to add the MCP server. For Claude Code, the guide gives a ready-made claude mcp add command. For Claude Desktop, the guide gives a config block using mcp-remote, which needs Node.js; then restart the app. For Windsurf, the guide gives a config block; then press Refresh in the MCP list. The install script is install.sh for macOS/Linux or install.ps1 for Windows, and it installs into every client found on the machine. The install script asks for the token with hidden input and backs up each file (.bak) first. Test connection in the MCP section confirms that the MCP server works.

items.title: MCP tools for managing knowledge
items.content: The AI Operations MCP server has six tools, all limited to your token's hub, with no owner parameter. The hub_info tool shows your hub, plan, saved sources and knowledge rows per type. The list_knowledge tool lists recent rows, filtered by type, status, sector or department. The import_url tool reads a JSON API and copies it into knowledge, with fields guessed, and dryRun to preview. The upsert_knowledge tool writes items the AI shaped itself, and the same id updates the row. The reindex_knowledge tool rebuilds the search index (vector + keyword) for rows still pending. The delete_knowledge tool deletes rows by id, in your own hub only. The list_knowledge, import_url and upsert_knowledge tools also take sector and fn (department; consult means the visitor chat).

items.title: Example requests to give your AI over MCP
items.content: Once the AI Operations MCP server is installed, you can give your AI requests in plain words. Example request: Call hub_info on astro-knowledge and tell me how much knowledge there is. Example request: Load https://api.myshop.com/products into the assistant as type product, dryRun first so I can check the mapping. Example request: Read this returns-policy.md, split it into self-contained FAQ items and upsert_knowledge them as type faq. You can review what was loaded with list_knowledge and remove rows with delete_knowledge.

items.title: svc-talk AI Secretary
items.content: The svc-talk AI Secretary is part of the Pro plan. You send work to the AI Secretary in one sentence, in the Secretary node or the command bar under the canvas, for example: Plan next month's new product line launch. Step 1: The Secretary frames the job and pauses for you to review. Step 2: The Secretary proposes a routing board showing which departments take part and which one leads. On the routing board, you can add or drop departments and change the lead, then approve. Step 3: The departments work, and links on the canvas light up as work is handed out and handoffs come back. Every task of the AI Secretary is one card you can view, approve step by step or re-run. Step 4: Integration cross-checks the handoffs and gives the verdict. The AI Secretary runs in the hosted workspace, for example the AI-Ecommerce workspace. The AI Secretary is not embeddable on other sites.

items.title: Approval, Auto mode and handoffs on Pro
items.content: On the Pro plan you stay in control: the Secretary proposes, you approve the routing, and each department pauses for approval at its key steps. Auto mode is switched on atop the Secretary panel. In Auto mode, the system approves each step, makes the images and hands on to the next department by itself. For a one-off job for one department, open that department's node directly, with no Secretary needed. On the Pro plan, handoffs are versioned. A handoff built on an older version of the upstream department's work is flagged needs re-checking, and you re-run it or keep it. On the Pro plan, approved results become knowledge that the next department and your consultant reuse.

The E-commerce sector is released today. The Education, F&B, Healthcare and Real Estate sectors are under expert review before release. Healthcare needs a clinician and Real Estate needs a lawyer to sign off before the final call. Any signed-in account can already trial every sector, unreleased ones included. A Pro account gets full access to released sectors and trial mode on the others.

items.title: The canvas workspace

Sign in to the workspace with the Account node (top right), using the account that bought the plan. The workspace canvas shows the Consult, the Secretary and every department as nodes. On the workspace canvas, links light up as work is handed out and comes back. A single command bar under the canvas lets you command every AI. The workspace opens in its own browser tab.

items.title: Data and security — how AI Operations protects your knowledge
items.content: AI Operations security is not a promise, but how the system is built. Isolation: every knowledge row is tied to your account and vector search runs in its own namespace, so no one can read, write or delete anyone else's knowledge. Tokens: your MCP token is emailed once and only its SHA-256 hash is kept. When you reissue the MCP token, the old one stops at once. Privacy: visitor conversations stay in their own browser for 30 days, and the server keeps no visitor chats. Server-side expertise: department prompts, processes and roles are assembled on the server only, never sent to the browser. Control: you approve before anything is final, and Auto runs only when you turn it on. Freedom: you can cancel any time through PayPal, and knowledge from your API stays in your own systems.
tags: dữ liệu có bị lộ không

items.title: Keeping the MCP token safe and reissuing it
items.content: Treat MCP_TOKEN like a password: whoever has it can load or delete your knowledge. Only the SHA-256 hash and the last 4 characters of MCP_TOKEN are stored. If MCP_TOKEN leaks or is lost, open the consultant's ⚙ → Load from API & MCP → Reissue token. You can also use Issue a new token in the MCP section of the guide. The old MCP token stops working at once, so set up your AI clients again with the new one. The owner (hub id) in the embed code is not a secret: it only lets the assistant read your knowledge to answer visitors.

items.title: Troubleshooting: answers are generic, not from my knowledge
items.content: If the svc-aide consultant answers generically instead of from your knowledge, check that the owner on the svc-aide tag is your hub id. Also check that your knowledge rows are active, because draft rows are never found. Also check that the division on the svc-aide tag matches the scope you loaded the rows for. Then ask your AI to call hub_info and look at pendingIndex; if rows are still waiting, run reindex_knowledge. Knowledge rows of type finance are never used to answer visitors.
tags: không trả lời theo dữ liệu

items.title: Troubleshooting: errors 401 and 402, and trial limits
items.content: Error 401 from your AI client means the MCP token is wrong or has been reissued. To fix error 401, paste the latest token and reinstall; Test connection in the MCP section of the guide confirms it. Error 402 means the AI Operations plan has lapsed. To fix error 402, renew the plan, then open the consultant's ⚙ once to refresh. On the Secretary or the departments, error 402 means the account is on Starter and Pro is needed. Trial limit reached in a workspace means the free trial for that sector is used up: 1 team task, 1 job per department, 30 messages. When the trial limit is reached, upgrade to Pro to keep going.

items.title: Troubleshooting: no assistant button on my site, or no token email
items.content: If there is no assistant button on your site, check that the script tag has type=module. The assistant button needs a platform that allows custom scripts, and some site builders block them on free tiers. When the assistant button does not show, open the browser console to look for a file load error. If there is no token email after buying, sign in to the AI-Ecommerce workspace → Consult → ⚙ → Load from API & MCP → Activate MCP; the token shows once. You can also use Issue a new token in the MCP section of the guide.

items.title: How is AI Operations different from a regular chatbot?
items.content: Scripted chatbots only answer what was written in advance, while AI Operations answers from your real knowledge and does real work for you. AI Operations answers from your own knowledge, with sources, while a scripted bot answers only from a pre-written script. AI Operations is updated with one API load or over MCP, while a scripted bot needs every flow edited by hand. AI Operations knowledge is scoped per sector and department, not one answer set for every situation. On the Pro plan, AI Operations does multi-step work with human approval, and departments hand off with a cross-check. A scripted bot only does questions and answers, with no process. AI Operations embeds with one script tag on any platform, while scripted bots are often locked to one platform.

items.title: Refund and cancellation policy
items.content: AI Operations subscriptions renew automatically through PayPal until cancelled. You can cancel any time in the Your plan panel on the pricing page or in your PayPal automatic payments. When you cancel, renewal stops, there are no further charges, and you keep using the plan until the end of the period already paid for. Cancelling during the 14-day free trial means no charge. Once a billing period has started, there are no refunds for the remaining or unused time. Refunds are given for duplicate charges, charges after a successful cancellation, billing errors on the AI Operations side, if the Service is discontinued, or where mandatory law requires. To ask for a refund, email dung.pham@goldenkey-software.com within 30 days of the charge. The full refund policy is on the Refund Policy page.

items.title: Terms, privacy and legal documents
items.content: AI Operations publishes five legal documents on its legal pages. The AI Operations legal documents are the Terms of Service (/system/legal/terms), the Privacy Policy (/system/legal/privacy) and the Billing, Cancellation & Refund Policy (/system/legal/refund). The AI Operations legal documents also include the Acceptable Use Policy (/system/legal/acceptable-use). The AI Operations legal documents also include the Data Processing Addendum (/system/legal/dpa) for customers who embed the consultant on their own website. Each AI Operations legal document is published in English and Vietnamese, with its effective date at the top of the page. By creating an account, buying a plan or using the service, customers agree to all five AI Operations legal documents. The provider of AI Operations is Golden Key IT Solutions Joint Stock Company (tax code 0316750591). The address of Golden Key IT Solutions Joint Stock Company is 17-19-21 Nguyen Van Troi Street, Phu Nhuan Ward, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam. The legal and privacy contact for AI Operations is dung.pham@goldenkey-software.com.

items.title: Terms of Service — key points
items.content: The AI Operations Terms of Service are published on the Terms of Service page. Under the Terms of Service, the service is for businesses and professional users aged 18 or over. Under the Terms of Service, you must keep passwords and the MCP_TOKEN secret, and you are responsible for activity under them. Under the Terms of Service, you keep all rights to your content. Under the Terms of Service, you grant Golden Key a licence only to host and process your content to provide the service, including sending it to the listed AI providers. Your content is never sold or used to train Golden Key's own models. Under the Terms of Service, usage limits such as 100 jobs a day on Pro and the trial quotas are part of each plan. Under the Terms of Service, features may change, with notice when a paid plan loses significant functionality. If the AI Operations service is discontinued entirely, customers get 30 days' notice and a refund of prepaid unused time.

items.title: AI output disclaimer
items.content: Under the AI Operations Terms of Service, answers, plans, articles, images and verdicts produced by AI are generated by third-party models. AI output may be inaccurate, incomplete, outdated or biased, and similar output may be produced for others. AI output is not legal, medical, financial, tax, investment or other professional advice. Customers must review AI output before using it, publishing it or making decisions on it. The approval steps and Auto mode are aids, not a substitute for human review. Healthcare and Real Estate work requires sign-off by a qualified professional. As between the parties, the customer owns the AI output generated for them, to the extent the law allows, with no warranty that it is free of third-party rights.

items.title: Customer duties when embedding the consultant
items.content: A customer who embeds svc-aide on their website is responsible for that website and its visitors. A customer who embeds svc-aide must tell visitors clearly that they are chatting with an AI. A customer who embeds svc-aide must publish their own privacy notice stating that questions are processed by AI Operations and AI model providers. A customer who embeds svc-aide must comply with the law that applies to them. For visitor data, the customer is the data controller and Golden Key is the processor under the Data Processing Addendum (DPA). Visitors with privacy requests should contact the business that owns the website. Privacy requests sent to AI Operations are forwarded to the business that owns the website.

items.title: Liability, suspension and changes to the terms
items.content: The AI Operations service and AI output are provided as is and as available, without warranties, to the extent the law allows. Under the AI Operations terms, neither party is liable for indirect or consequential damages or lost profits, revenue or data. Golden Key's total liability is capped at what the customer paid in the previous 12 months, or USD 50 for free use. These liability limits do not apply where the law does not allow such limits, such as fraud or mandatory consumer rights. Customers indemnify Golden Key for claims arising from their content, their breach of the terms or claims by their website visitors. Golden Key may suspend or terminate accounts for breach, non-payment, legal requirements or security risks. Material changes to the AI Operations terms are announced by email or in the service at least 15 days before they take effect.

items.title: Governing law and disputes
items.content: The AI Operations terms are governed by the laws of Vietnam, and the UN CISG does not apply. Before going to court, contact dung.pham@goldenkey-software.com, and both sides negotiate in good faith for 30 days. Unresolved disputes about AI Operations go to the competent courts of Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam. Consumers keep the mandatory rights of their country of residence, including suing in their local courts where that law allows. Customers in Vietnam are protected by the Law on Protection of Consumers' Rights and may also complain to the consumer-protection authority. Electronic invoices for AI Operations are issued under Vietnamese tax law when invoicing details are provided. For customers in Vietnam the Vietnamese text of the terms prevails, and for everyone else the English text prevails.

items.title: Failed payments, price changes and changing plans
items.content: Under the AI Operations Billing & Refund Policy, prices are in USD on the pricing page. Taxes or currency-conversion fees are borne by the customer, and the amount charged is the one shown at checkout. AI Operations allows one free trial per customer, and trial abuse such as multiple accounts may be refused. A failed renewal keeps the plan working for 3 grace days, then the service is suspended until payment succeeds, with data kept. New AI Operations prices apply to new subscriptions. Existing subscriptions keep their price unless customers get at least 30 days' notice before the next renewal. To change plans, for example from Starter to Pro, cancel the current subscription and subscribe to the new one. A new plan is billed from the day you subscribe, with knowledge, token and embed code unchanged, and no credit for the old plan's remaining time. Contact support before opening a PayPal dispute or chargeback.

items.title: What personal data AI Operations collects
items.content: The AI Operations Privacy Policy is published on the Privacy Policy page. AI Operations collects account data: email, display name, avatar and the sign-in provider id, for example Google. Passwords are kept hashed by the authentication provider. AI Operations collects billing data: PayPal subscription id, status, plan, interval, payer id, trial and renewal dates. AI Operations never collects card or bank numbers. AI Operations stores customer content: knowledge, source URLs, files and text loaded over MCP, and messages and work given to the Secretary and departments. Visitor questions to the consultant are processed to answer and not stored on the servers. AI Operations collects technical data, IP address and request metadata, for rate limiting and security, not for profiling. AI Operations also keeps the SHA-256 hash and last 4 characters of the MCP token, trial counters, and emails customers send. Golden Key is controller for account and billing data, and processor for customer content and visitor data.

items.title: AI providers, sub-processors and data transfers
items.content: AI Operations never sells personal data or shares it for targeted advertising. To answer and do work, customer content and visitor questions are sent to AI model providers. For text, AI Operations uses OpenRouter (and the model providers it routes to), Cloudflare Workers AI and NVIDIA. For images, AI Operations uses Hugging Face, and for embeddings AI Operations uses Cloudflare Workers AI. Some free models routed through OpenRouter may have inputs logged or used by their provider under its own policy. Customers should not load sensitive data into AI Operations unless necessary and lawful. The other sub-processors of AI Operations are Cloudflare (servers, databases, vector search, rate limiting), Supabase (authentication, profiles) and Google (optional sign-in). AI Operations also uses PayPal (payments), Resend (email) and the website hosting/CDN provider as sub-processors. AI Operations data may be processed in the US, the EU and elsewhere. Data transfers are protected by safeguards such as the EU Standard Contractual Clauses and Vietnam's cross-border transfer assessment.

items.title: Data retention and deletion
items.content: AI Operations keeps account data while the account exists. Customer knowledge and the hub are kept even after a plan ends, so renewing resumes at once. Secretary and department group chats, jobs and handoffs are permanently deleted after 30 days. Results approved into knowledge are kept after the 30 days. Billing records are kept as accounting and tax law requires, and trial counters are kept to enforce trial quotas. Visitor chat history lives only in the visitor's browser for 30 days. To delete AI Operations data, email dung.pham@goldenkey-software.com. Deletion is completed within 30 days, or sooner where the law requires, and backups and provider logs may persist briefly. Customers can export knowledge first with list_knowledge over MCP. AI Operations has no self-service account deletion button yet, so deletion is by request.

items.title: Privacy rights and how to use them
items.content: Users of AI Operations can ask to access, correct, delete, restrict or object to processing of their personal data. Users of AI Operations can also receive a copy of their data, withdraw consent and complain. To use these privacy rights, email dung.pham@goldenkey-software.com. Identity may be verified, and replies come within 30 days or sooner where the law requires. EU and UK residents (GDPR, UK GDPR) may complain to their data protection authority. US residents, including California (CCPA/CPRA), may know, delete and correct their data, may use an authorised agent, and are not discriminated against. AI Operations does not sell or share personal information as defined in CCPA/CPRA. In Vietnam, under the Law on Personal Data Protection, data subjects have the statutory rights, including consent and withdrawal, complaints and compensation. Data subjects in Vietnam may complain to the data protection authority of the Ministry of Public Security. The AI Operations service is not for anyone under 18.

items.title: Cookies and browser storage
items.content: AI Operations uses no analytics or advertising cookies. AI Operations uses only the following cookies and browser storage. AI Operations uses a theme cookie and a language cookie that remember light/dark mode and the VI/EN choice. AI Operations uses browser localStorage for the sign-in session and for a random id that keeps a visitor's consultant chat history apart. AI Operations uses IndexedDB for the chat history itself, stored only on the user's device for 30 days. PayPal and Google may set their own cookies when someone pays or signs in through them.

items.title: Security measures and breach notification
items.content: AI Operations protects data with HTTPS/TLS encryption in transit and per-customer isolation of knowledge, with vector search in a separate namespace. AI Operations stores MCP tokens only as SHA-256 hashes and invalidates them at once on reissue. AI Operations runs department prompts and processes only on the server and uses role-based access control. No system is perfectly secure. If a personal data breach occurs, affected customers are notified without undue delay, aiming for within 72 hours under the Data Processing Addendum. After a personal data breach, authorities are notified within the time the law requires. Security vulnerabilities should be reported privately to dung.pham@goldenkey-software.com, with reasonable time to fix them before disclosure.

items.title: Acceptable Use Policy — what is not allowed
items.content: The AI Operations Acceptable Use Policy is published on the Acceptable Use Policy page. The Acceptable Use Policy prohibits anything illegal. The Acceptable Use Policy prohibits infringing intellectual property or privacy, including importing data the customer has no right to use. The Acceptable Use Policy prohibits scams, phishing, impersonation, fake reviews or misleading consumers. The Acceptable Use Policy prohibits child sexual abuse material, with zero tolerance and reports to authorities. The Acceptable Use Policy prohibits sexually explicit content, extreme violence, terrorism, hate or harassment. The Acceptable Use Policy prohibits malware, spam, and processing sensitive personal data without a lawful basis. The Acceptable Use Policy prohibits automated decisions with legal or significant effects (medical, legal, credit, hiring, housing, insurance) without a qualified human reviewing them. The Acceptable Use Policy prohibits election manipulation and weapons instructions. The Acceptable Use Policy prohibits hiding that visitors talk to an AI where the law requires disclosure.

items.title: Acceptable Use Policy — technical misuse and enforcement
items.content: The AI Operations Acceptable Use Policy forbids bypassing rate limits, plan limits or trial quotas, for example with multiple accounts. The Acceptable Use Policy forbids probing or scanning for vulnerabilities without permission, accessing other customers' data, or overloading the system. The Acceptable Use Policy forbids reverse engineering or trying to extract the service's prompts, processes or source code. The Acceptable Use Policy forbids sharing, reselling or renting accounts, MCP tokens or access without an agreement. AI Operations customers must also follow the usage policies of the AI model providers. Violations of the Acceptable Use Policy can lead to content removal, token revocation, suspension or termination, and reports to authorities. Serious violations of the Acceptable Use Policy are not refunded. Report abuse or security issues privately to dung.pham@goldenkey-software.com.

items.title: Data Processing Addendum (DPA) — summary
items.content: The AI Operations Data Processing Addendum (DPA) is part of the Terms. The Data Processing Addendum applies to personal data in customer knowledge, Secretary and department work, and visitor questions on embedded consultants. Under the Data Processing Addendum, the customer is the controller and Golden Key the processor, acting only on documented instructions. The Data Processing Addendum covers confidentiality, security measures and general authorisation of the listed sub-processors. Under the Data Processing Addendum, customers may terminate if they reasonably object to a new sub-processor. The Data Processing Addendum covers help with data-subject requests and impact assessments, and breach notice aiming within 72 hours. The Data Processing Addendum covers deletion within 30 days on request and audit information once a year. The Data Processing Addendum covers the EU Standard Contractual Clauses (2021) and UK Addendum for transfers, and Vietnamese personal data protection obligations. Under the Data Processing Addendum, customers must have a lawful basis for their data and tell visitors their questions are processed by AI.

items.title: Zap Chrome extensions
items.content: Golden Key IT Solutions also makes two Chrome extensions, sold separately from the AI Operations plans. Zap Share posts the page you are viewing to Facebook, Instagram, Threads, LinkedIn and X in one click. Zap Support answers customers automatically in Messenger, Zalo, Business Suite or any web chat, with an AI that runs on your own computer. Each Zap extension has its own page with features, prices and the license key. The Zap extensions are paid in VND by VietQR bank transfer, not by PayPal. The Zap extensions are bought separately; the Starter and Pro plans do not include them.

items.title: Zap Share — post once to 5 social networks
items.content: Zap Share is a Chrome extension that posts the page you are viewing to Facebook, Instagram, Threads, LinkedIn and X from your own accounts. Zap Share fills in the title, description, tags and images or video from the page, and you can press 🎯 to pick them again. Zap Share writes a separate text for each network and shortens it to fit the limit, such as 280 characters on X and 500 on Threads. Zap Share can collect many posts from many pages and post now or schedule up to 7 days ahead. Zap Share takes images up to 10 MB and video up to 100 MB, from the page, Ctrl+V, drag and drop or a file. Zap Share turns each network icon green once the post is live and spaces out Facebook posts to avoid spam flags. Zap Share has 3 free posts, then costs 19,000 VND/month or 205,200 VND/year (10% off).

items.title: Zap Share questions
items.content: In Zap Share, one press of Post or Schedule counts as one post, however many networks it goes to. If a Zap Share post lands nowhere, the post is given back. Every new account gets 3 free Zap Share posts. Zap Share scheduled posts live only in Chrome memory, so Chrome must stay open until the posting time. Zap Share posts from the accounts signed in to your Chrome. Zap Share post content, images and social accounts never leave your browser. The Zap Share server only sees your license key, a random install id and how many posts were used. When Zap Share time runs out, the Post button is locked until you renew.

items.title: Zap Support — automatic replies in your chat
items.content: Zap Support is a Chrome extension that answers customers right in the chat you already use: Messenger, Zalo, Business Suite or any web chat. Zap Support reads the customer message, searches your own knowledge, then replies on its own or drafts a reply for you to approve. The Zap Support AI model downloads once and runs on your own CPU or GPU, with no AI server and no message cap. Zap Support loads products, prices and policies from an API link or a JSON file and never invents numbers that are not there. In Zap Support you press 🎯 to point at the message list and the composer, or use ✨ Auto-detect. Zap Support alerts you when a customer complains, asks for a human or leaves a phone number, and pauses a chat when you type in yourself. Zap Support has a 1-day free trial, then costs 29,000 VND/month or 313,200 VND/year (10% off).

items.title: Zap Support questions
items.content: The Zap Support trial is 1 day of full use and starts the first time the extension checks your key, so creating the key early loses nothing. Zap Support needs Chrome 137 or newer on a computer. The Zap Support AI model is a few hundred MB, downloads once and runs on the CPU, or the GPU when faster. The Zap Support CPU level is adjustable so the computer stays smooth. Zap Support answers in a chat tab open in your Chrome, so it stops when the computer is off or the tab is closed. Zap Support customer messages, your knowledge and chat accounts never leave your browser. The Zap Support server only sees your license key and a random install id. When Zap Support time runs out, the bot stops replying until you renew.

items.title: Zap extension payment and license key
items.content: Zap Share and Zap Support are prepaid in VND by VietQR bank transfer to TPBank, and they never renew or charge automatically. Each Zap transfer adds 30 days (monthly) or 365 days (yearly) to your access, counted from your current end date, so renewing early never loses days. The yearly Zap plan is 10% off the monthly price. To buy, sign in on the extension page, pick a plan, scan the VietQR code and press Paid; the transfer note starts with the order code. A Zap plan starts as soon as you press Paid, and the shop then checks its bank statement. If the money never arrives, the added time is taken back. Your Zap license key is under My key on the extension page and works on up to 3 computers. Changed computers? Create a new Zap key under My key, and the old computers must enter the new key.
